cautions.en: This is a teaching model assembled from several atlases, not a scan of one person, and no anatomist has reviewed it. BodyParts3D itself warns that organs may overlap or leave gaps and that vessels and airways are modelled as solid tubes.
cautions.zh: 本模型由多套图谱数据拼合而成，并非某一个人的扫描结果，也未经解剖学专家审校。BodyParts3D 原始数据自身说明：器官之间可能相互重叠或留有空隙，血管和气道以实心管表示。

cautions.en: Peripheral nerves, joint ligaments, fasciae, lymph nodes and the thyroid (880 parts from Z-Anatomy and Open3DModel) are artist-modelled and were fitted to this body by a non-rigid registration: expect about 2 mm error typically and 7–8 mm in one case out of ten, more in the thigh and leg.
cautions.zh: 周围神经、关节韧带、筋膜、淋巴结和甲状腺（共 880 个部件，来自 Z-Anatomy 与 Open3DModel）为美术建模，经非刚性配准贴合到本模型：位置误差一般约 2 mm，约十分之一的情况达 7–8 mm，大腿和小腿处更大。

cautions.en: Nerve courses were corrected automatically: 22% of nerve centreline points were pushed out of bone or muscle bellies (3.6 mm on average), 4% of nerve length still runs deep inside muscle, and tube thickness is schematic.
cautions.zh: 神经走行经过自动修正：约 22% 的神经中心线点被从骨或肌腹内推出（平均 3.6 mm），仍有约 4% 的神经长度位于肌腹深部；神经粗细仅为示意。

cautions.en: 79 parts (lung lobes, abdominal wall muscles, latissimus dorsi, muscles of mastication and facial expression) come from the older BodyParts3D 3.0 body and were warped into this one: about 1.4 mm error in the head, 3.6 mm in the thorax and 6.4 mm in the abdomen (medians). Thin facial muscles were flattened onto the skull.
cautions.zh: 有 79 个部件（肺叶、腹壁肌、背阔肌、咀嚼肌和表情肌）取自较早的 BodyParts3D 3.0 人体，经形变移入本模型：位置误差中位数在头部约 1.4 mm、胸部约 3.6 mm、腹部约 6.4 mm；较薄的表情肌被压贴在颅骨表面。

cautions.en: Transversus abdominis is the worst-fitting muscle: about a third of its surface lies inside neighbouring organs and muscles (stomach, colon, diaphragm), 5% of it deeper than 4 mm. The right lung base sits too high for the bronchi drawn inside it.
cautions.zh: 腹横肌贴合最差：约三分之一的表面嵌入相邻器官和肌肉（胃、结肠、膈），其中 5% 深度超过 4 mm。右肺底位置偏高，与其内部的支气管不完全吻合。

cautions.en: Missing structures: phrenic nerve, cervical plexus branches, great auricular and occipital nerves, splanchnic nerves; the spinal cord itself (only its central canal); pleura, pericardium and most peritoneum; cruciate ligaments and menisci of the knee; parotid gland; inferior parathyroids; middle and inner ear; fat. The liver exists only as its eight segments, the heart only as chamber walls and valves.
cautions.zh: 缺失的结构：膈神经、颈丛分支、耳大神经和枕神经、内脏神经；脊髓本体（仅有中央管）；胸膜、心包和大部分腹膜；膝关节交叉韧带和半月板；腮腺；下甲状旁腺；中耳和内耳；脂肪。肝脏只以肝段形式存在，心脏只有心腔壁和瓣膜。

cautions.en: Left/right labels of five structures were wrong in the source and corrected here from their position: flexor pollicis brevis, brachium of superior colliculus, middle pharyngeal constrictor, ascending lumbar vein (labels swapped) and one fibular vein. For heart, liver and coronary structures "left/right" in a name refers to the organ, not the side of the body.
cautions.zh: 原始数据中有五处结构的左右标注有误，已按实际位置更正：拇短屈肌、上丘臂、咽中缩肌、腰升静脉（左右互换）以及一条腓静脉。心、肝及冠状血管名称中的“左/右”指器官自身的左右，而非身体的左右侧。

cautions.en: The "superficial" and "deep" muscle layers are computed geometrically (how much of a muscle faces the skin uncovered), not taken from a textbook: rectus abdominis, for example, counts as deep because the external oblique aponeurosis covers it in this model.
cautions.zh: 肌肉的“浅层/深层”是按几何关系自动计算的（肌肉表面有多少直接朝向皮肤而未被遮盖），并非取自教科书分层：例如腹直肌在本模型中被腹外斜肌腱膜覆盖，因而归入深层。

cautions.en: Meshes were simplified (largest deviation 0.8 mm) and the feet point downwards as in the scanner; lower-limb lymph nodes and several knee, shoulder and ankle ligaments were left out because they did not fit this body.
cautions.zh: 网格经过简化（最大偏差 0.8 mm）；双足呈扫描时的跖屈姿势。下肢部分淋巴结以及膝、肩、踝的若干韧带因无法贴合本模型而未收录。
